procedure: cargo test --locked --workspace; crates/cw-sim/tests/events.rs (18 fixtures: every card and choice resolves with balanced books; each state trigger opens from its real transition; scoped freight, outage, recall, permit, covenant and tender handlers; rival mandatory cards never pause the player; dissolved subjects resolve; pending cards survive reload; authority; both starts run a year). cw-session example event_census for natural-play frequency.
limitations: Several player-only cards (review, tender, covenant, hostile stake, bargaining) appear only after the corresponding player action or state. Fuel shocks reduce fuel supply a fifth rather than setting a reference price. Recession recovery is a clean 26-week end, not a two-quarter taper.
